history.summary: Freehold 2BR at Haig Court (D15 East Coast) at $2.35M / $2184 PSF, with a strong 6.7%/yr URA appreciation rate on a moderate 41-txn series and a low technical score (433). Listing is ~3% above the $2126 district median; freehold tenure and the deep East Coast buyer pool support it, but the 2004 age, 950m MRT walk and weak Elo/score temper the case to Neutral.
history.rating_rationale: Appreciation 6.7%/yr is the headline strength (41 txn — moderate reliability), and freehold D15 with deep buyer pool is structurally liquid. But score_1000 of 433 is well below market-typical (500), the unit is 22 years old, MRT is a 950m/11-min walk, and PSF sits ~3% over median with no fresh catalyst. Mixed signals net to Neutral.
red_flags: Very low technical score (433) despite high Elo
catalysts: Freehold tenure in deep-buyer-pool D15 East Coast
Lifestyle district with durable owner-occupier demand

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: 2BR freehold in East Coast rents well to professionals and expat couples; the 1076 sqft 2BR is generously sized and marketable. Yield modest at $2.35M but tenant demand is reliable.
